correctness.rationale: Prime-uniform exact proof: five STFT translation rows, two degree-one roots and one unit-coefficient quadratic. A sampled central zero forces equilateral phase ratios and precludes both side roots. Thus sharp support 5p-2; equality is a disjoint p^2 two-torus and 4p^2 circle family, counted via four independent phase ratios modulo two global phases. Explicit constructions realize all three spectrum values.
